figures.caption: Figure 1: The model computes a population trajectory from training-subject labels (blue) and a single scalar gain from the test subject's own EEG (red), combined multiplicatively around the scale midpoint.
Figure 2: Component ablation ladder. Bars: repeated leave4-out cross-validation (N=100, mean ± std). Diamonds: the same ladder evaluated once on held-out test subjects (n=4, no error bar).
